title: Pubnet contract event with eight topics whose data is an SCV_I32
why: Contract event data is any SCVal; signed 32-bit data is rare next to i128 amounts, and this event also has eight topics of five types with a string, not a symbol, first. Readers that assume a symbol first topic or an amount-like data value misread it.
notes: Chosen with the locate index of the full pubnet scan (token `X|ev|op:INVOKE_HOST_FUNCTION#ev=CONTRACT:nosym:n=5-16:I32`): among the ledgers that hold the shape, the one with the smallest lake object. Header hash recomputed from the header and every transaction hash recomputed from its envelope at capture. `expect.values` are written by hand from the decoded sidecar; participants, state changes and movements are the reference extractor's output, checked against the sidecar.

values.note: SCV_I32 (arm 4); SEP-51 renders it as a JSON number.
